honest_caveats: The commission's '12 states' framing does not match the accepted P07. The measured reachable union is 17 strings (6 P07 decisions + DISTINCT_BY_DEFAULT + OUT_OF_SCOPE + 7 forbidden backfill target states + UNKNOWN_OVERLAP/PROVENANCE_ONLY/ALIAS_ONLY matrix defaults). The precedence LADDER is exactly 6. Reported as measured, not forced to 12.

The differential harness CAUGHT three real native defects that I then fixed: descriptive kinds returning the wrong MATRIX default, a completely missing unknown-kind hard negative, and a dict-comparison sort that is impossible in C.

The invalid-input stress sweep CAUGHT two memory-safety defects: the trusted canonicalize can return its input unchanged (so treating the result as owned stole a caller reference), and a caller-supplied directionality_or_symmetric arrived borrowed yet was DECREFed at cleanup. Both produced EXC_BAD_ACCESS on a later call. A third defect (double free of the source-ref fast sequence) produced a bus error. All are fixed, documented, and now regression-tested.

The multi-positive CONFLICTING_AUTHORITY branch and precedence TIES are implemented and precedence-ordered but are NOT yet exercised by a two-candidate corpus, because the synthetic corpus in this repository admits only one relation and forging a second valid relation requires constructor material this harness does not build. This is a named coverage gap, not a claimed pass.
The multi-candidate conflict ordering and the two-candidate conflict ordering remain unproven; only the single-candidate ladder is proven against the oracle.

The broad-regression digest 72d0a5ca... reproduces the HQ244 invocation EXACTLY. It does NOT match the HQ242 digest 278854ee..., and no invented HQ242 digest pass is claimed. The delta is 9 collection errors from genuinely absent optional dependencies (pandas, pyarrow, d07 harness), already documented by HQ244.
from_c11 direct construction is NOT implemented; it is recorded as Stage C work.
The native owner may return AUTHORIZED inside the quarantined harness purely as an implementation comparison. It is not adopted runtime authority and is not wired into production P07/F7.
Parity is exact for the corpus exercised. It is not proof of parity over all possible inputs; that remains Stage C/D work.
